item.description: - New: change any shortcut. Open Settings › Shortcuts, click a shortcut and press the new keys. Esc cancels, Delete removes it, ↺ brings one row back. - New shortcut presets: Butterfly (as before), AeroSpace style (⌥ instead of ⌃⌥) and Hyper key (for Caps Lock set up as ⌃⌥⇧⌘ in Karabiner, Raycast or BetterTouchTool). - Essentials at the top of Settings › Shortcuts: the shortcuts people use most, in one place. - Butterfly warns before a new shortcut collides: with another Butterfly shortcut (Replace), with macOS (for example Mission Control), or with ⌥ + letter, which types special characters. - The tour, tips and menus show your current shortcuts. - Butterfly now offers to move itself to Applications when opened from the disk image or Downloads, so updates keep working. - Overview opens on an empty workspace too, with a "No windows in this workspace" note and the workspace pills, so you can switch from there. With only one workspace and no windows, a short hint tells you to open an app. - Overview bends evenly around the middle of the screen, whichever window has focus.

- New: shake windows out of tabs. On the window map, grab a group of tabs and shake it left and right. The tabs come apart and the windows go back on the strip side by side. Works with a mouse and a trackpad. - New: take one window out of a stack or a tab group. Drag it from the window map into a gap between other windows and it gets its own column. - The Classic map can now combine windows into tabs too: rest a dragged window over the middle of another one, and drop it when "Combine into tabs" shows up. - A tab group on the Classic map shows the icons of its tabs side by side, not only the active one. - Clearer full width: the tour and a one-time tip now show that ⌃⌥F makes a window full width and that it stays on the strip, so you can still move it with ⌃⌥⇧← / →. - New Check for Updates button in Settings › General. - Butterfly map: wing tiles get their app icons back after a window returns to the map, and a window that became a tab no longer leaves an extra tile behind.

- A window you resized by hand on your other display no longer snaps back to its old width when you move windows on the first display. - The wing sound is now off unless you turn it on, and Full Butterfly no longer turns it on. If you had it on, the update turns it off once. Turn it back on in the menu bar (Wing sound) or in Settings › General, right under Theme.
